target.statement: IterComp achieves a Complex score of 0.4873 on T2I-CompBench, outperforming all baselines.

compute.basis: Training requires 4 A100 GPUs for multiple iterations, and evaluation on T2I-CompBench involves generating thousands of images.

blockers: Requires 4 NVIDIA A100 GPUs for training
Training involves multiple iterations and large datasets
Evaluation requires generating many images and computing metrics
title: IterComp: Iterative Composition-Aware Feedback Learning from Model Gallery for Text-to-Image Generation
